localDeltaObservation.evidence: The fork default master is six commits ahead and zero behind the upstream master baseline. The local-ahead delta ports the mod to NeoForge 1.21.1, replaces unsafe combat/network behavior with server-authoritative state and custom payloads, adds GameTests and client/server/multiplayer runtime harnesses, documents compatibility/protocol/public API boundaries, and preserves fork/license provenance.

understandability.claim: The local-ahead documentation records the Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1 / Java 21 target, dual-wield interaction model, authoritative off-hand attack flow, cooldown/HUD behavior, compatibility limitations, acceptance commands, and explicit automated-versus-manual evidence boundaries.

verification.claim: The final PR-head release gate passed build/audit, ten required NeoForge GameTests, dedicated-server and physical-client bootstrap, integrated real-input/HUD checks, modded-client-to-vanilla-server and vanilla-client-to-modded-server paths, two-client multiplayer, lifecycle, network-stress, release-resource audit, and JAR audit. The tested head and current default commit have the identical Git tree a5b60f6c9af607be5ecba3d678a0e4bb665cb7a7; this is content-equivalence evidence, not a claim that Actions directly executed current merge commit 317c2ec2e40325d8dd41f6dc5e730e95c97ae7e1.

The current default tree keeps the same executable release matrix and harnesses used by the successful validated tree, including 10/10 GameTest acceptance plus dedicated, physical-client, real-input/HUD, vanilla-peer, multiplayer lifecycle, and network-stress paths.

reproducibility.claim: The local delta records the Java 21, Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge 21.1 build/runtime contract, Gradle wrapper/bootstrap path, source-integrity manifest, and commands used for build, GameTest and runtime acceptance. This supports reconstruction of the tested environment but does not claim byte-identical rebuild determinism.

interoperability.claim: The local delta defines NeoForge/client-server protocol boundaries, explicitly discourages overlapping combat-authority mods without claiming compatibility, and documents optional-peer behavior and the custom payload state machine instead of modifying vanilla packet serialization.

The validated tree passed a modded NeoForge client against a Mojang vanilla server, a vanilla Mojang client against the NeoForge server with the mod installed, and two-client multiplayer/lifecycle paths.

security-safety.claim: The local port rejects vanilla packet-format mutation, live inventory/attribute swapping, hurt-immunity clearing and early interaction theft; it uses server-authoritative off-hand state, ordered custom-payload sequences, held-state/target validation, replay hardening, vanilla attack semantics, and excludes GameTest-only resources from the release JAR.

stewardship.claim: The local delta retains the upstream MIT notice, records 2026 fork contributions and third-party provenance, documents excluded/independently adapted sources and asset licensing, and maintains an explicit audit/test matrix for the port.
